description: This file defines an interface for conditional elements in the MiniLang component of the Ofbiz framework, specifically for handling 'if' conditionals within the MiniLang scripting language.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: Interface for all conditional elements under the <if> element within MiniLang, providing methods for checking conditions and pretty printing.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition within a given method context, returning true if the condition holds, otherwise false. May throw MiniLangException.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Outputs a human-readable representation of the conditional element into the provided StringBuilder, using the given method context.
